problem_closed: Runtime evidence that is younger than the generic freshness ceiling can no longer be promoted after the deterministic hourly repertory has advanced to a different production.

design_decision.observed: The repertory changes at exact UTC hour boundaries while the prior freshness contract allowed evidence up to 70 minutes old.
design_decision.inferred: Age-only freshness can admit a correctly verified but no-longer-current stage across an hourly boundary.
design_decision.experiment: Layer a fail-closed current-hour gate over the identity-bound v2 verifier and expose the exact stage expiration instant.
design_decision.current_decision: Promotion requires checked_at to remain strictly before the next UTC hour boundary computed from observed_at.

rollback: Stop consuming verifyRuntimeStageFreshness.v3.cjs and return callers to the untouched v2 contract; revert this record, test, and implementation commits if removal is required.
next_action: Wire v3 into the final runtime-evidence promotion path, then verify one fresh runtime_dom_probe before and at an exact UTC hour boundary against an immutable successful Vercel deployment after provider capacity returns.
